scope: Same-question counterfactual: Hybrid retrieval re-ranked under the per-query temporal mask, against the shipped rankings.

estimands.delta_mask: F1(masked RAG) - F1(unmasked RAG), paired within question
estimands.delta_rag_masked: F1(masked RAG) - F1(closed-book), paired within question
estimands.delta_rag_unmasked: F1(unmasked RAG) - F1(closed-book), paired within question

why: The selected-subset analysis compared different questions (179/404 Static retained against 398/474 Fresh) and so could not identify the mask's effect. These contrasts are within question.
